procedure_name: Permanent Driving License & Automated Track Test
summary: Booking driving skill track test and obtaining chip-embedded PVC Smart Card Driving License.
estimated_total_cost: ₹200 driving test fee + ₹200 smart card fee

steps.title: Wait minimum 30 days after LL
steps.description: Candidate must have held valid Learner's License for at least 30 days before booking DL test slot.

steps.title: Book automated driving test slot
steps.description: Select date and preferred RTO automated test track on Sarathi portal.

steps.title: Appear at automated driving test track
steps.description: Drive on sensor-equipped track executing reverse-S, parallel parking, eight-curve, and gradient stop without hitting poles.
documents_needed: Vehicle with valid RC, Insurance, PUC

steps.title: Biometric and photograph capture
steps.description: RTO staff captures digital photograph and signature for printing on smart card.

steps.title: Dispatch of Smart Card Driving License
steps.description: High-security PVC Smart Card Driving License dispatched by Speed Post to residential address.
